title: Pharmacokinetics
description: A drug does its work only while its level stays between too little and too much; the body clears it steadily. Unlocks the Dosing Pump.

puzzle.goal: A dose gives a level L that falls by first-order clearance at rate k. Write the level C after a time t.
puzzle.name: One-compartment decay
puzzle.ask: Find C for L = @{L}, k = @{k} and t = @{t}.
puzzle.method: The body clears a fixed share each hour, so the level decays exponentially; half-life ln(2)/k.
